title: MAKING YOUR LLMS MORE OBJECTIVE: STABILIZING LLM SAFETY BEHAVIOR ACROSS TRAITS WITH TRAIT-INVARIANT SAFETY TUNING
reasoning: The paper focuses on how safety mechanisms (refusal behavior) in Large Language Models are affected by assigned traits or personas in system prompts, and introduces a method to stabilize these safety behaviors. It does not evaluate, benchmark, or discuss religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
